payout_quote: earn 33% royalties for photos, vectors, illustrations, and 35% for videos and 3D assets
steps: Create a free Adobe ID and apply as an Adobe Stock contributor with a portfolio of original photos, vectors, illustrations, video, or 3D assets.
Upload assets; each file passes Adobe's content review and keywording/approval before it goes live in the marketplace.
Customers license your assets; your royalty share (33% non-video / 35% video and 3D) accrues on each sale.
Withdraw earnings once you reach the payout threshold via the contributor payout options.
catches: No guaranteed sales: thousands of contributors compete; most assets earn little or nothing.
Content must pass review — rejected files earn nothing and cost you production time.
You must own the rights to everything you upload; model/property releases are your responsibility.
Royalty rates are fixed shares (33%/35%); you do not control the sale price.
biggest_catch: This is speculative content sales, not guaranteed work: most contributors earn little, and every file must pass Adobe's review before it can sell.
eligibility: Creators 18+ with wholly original content (photos, vectors, illustrations, video, 3D) that passes Adobe's review.
timing: Assets sell whenever customers license them; payouts accrue per sale.
